technology_name: Method for Selective Synthesis of 2-Substituted Benzimidazoles
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Industrial manufacturing of mono-substituted benzimidazole variants frequently suffers from low catalytic conversion rates and complex purification steps that hinder high-volume commercial scaling.
description: An optimized, atom-economical protocol utilizing a single, readily available catalyst under specific vacuum conditions to synthesize pure 2-substituted benzimidazoles in a single step, bypassing secondary purification constraints.
applications: Antiviral and anti-inflammatory drug production, antimicrobial coatings, veterinary medicine formulation, and industrial fine chemical manufacturing.
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care
